item.title: Implement cursor pagination for GET /items
item.brief: Implement GET /items cursor pagination exactly as the shared contract: optional limit integer 1..100 default 20; opaque cursor; JSON {items:[...],next_cursor:string|null}; preserve id order; next_cursor null at end; invalid limit/cursor returns HTTP 400 with {error:"..."}. Update README and keep python3 -m unittest passing. Commit the change.

pr.summary: Added cursor pagination to GET /items. Callers can retrieve ordered pages with a default size of 20 and follow opaque next_cursor values. Before: the endpoint returned all items in one response without a continuation field; now: pages return items and a continuation cursor, or null on the last page.
